info.title: GoBadminton API — critical pilot design
info.description: DESIGN_DRAFT. F-01 foundation. F-02 browser identity/session. F-03 organizer/venue/game publish + public discovery. F-04 transactional participation loop. Game-scoped authority. Checkpoint B: optional self-declared TrainerProfile; required activityKind regular|trainer_led; external settlement purpose no_trainer_fee|trainer_fee; trainer fee fixed per_player_per_session or by_agreement. Authenticated GET /me/games lists Games with active game_managers for the session user (draft/unlisted included; management.role + createdByMe). Unlisted share-token access remains out of scope. See docs/api/API_POLICY.md. LS-01: opt-in SocialProfile/directory/looking-for-game, Radar consent storage (no matching), block/report; SOCIAL_DIRECTORY_ENABLED default off. LS-R1: ephemeral Radar presence/matching + resultRef preview; SOCIAL_RADAR_ENABLED default off. SOCIAL_RADAR_DEMO_ENABLED default off enables synthetic/internal city-scoped Radar for deterministic demo identities only; live real-user Radar remains gated. LS-03: lean 1:1 text DM (request/accept/decline/send/list/read); SOCIAL_DM_ENABLED default off; polling-first; optional discoveryProof seam. LS-04: GameInvitation as a separate Sessions resource (manager invite, capacity-safe accept, block/expiry/idempotency); SOCIAL_INVITATIONS_ENABLED default off; pending invite reserves zero seats. LS-R2: discoveryProof/resultRef is viewer/session/generation-bound and revalidated against current Radar activations, expiry, radius/cohort, block and eligibility at preview and first-contact redemption; not a bearer grant; SOCIAL_RADAR_ENABLED remains default off. LS-05: text-only Game Chat scoped to current manager/confirmed membership with cancel/endsAt lifecycle fences; SOCIAL_GAME_CHAT_ENABLED default off; optional DM gameContextId for applicant clarification without room access. LS-06: lean composed Inbox read model over DM + GameInvitation + Game Chat (no second write ownership); SOCIAL_INBOX_ENABLED default off; polling-first. Account security: linked-provider link/unlink bound to current session (no email auto-link) and own session list/revoke/revoke-others. Venue A1a: catalog search, unverified find-or-propose, race-safe exact identity reservation, advisory fuzzy duplicates, confirm-distinct tokens. Legacy POST /venues is compatibility-only and cannot self-verify. G1 source-staged radar-geographic-v1: independent OFF-viewer city/nearby, coarse WGS84 center, exact geographic consent evidence, strict v2 proof and atomic revocation. SOCIAL_RADAR_GEOGRAPHIC_ENABLED defaults false; no cutover/deployment implied. GMap-1: public bounded city-wide Games map aggregate, shared upcoming/venue discovery filters, canonical Venue read projection; no map renderer or deployment.

requestBody.description: Raw image bytes; normal web client sends only an on-device oriented, center-cropped 512x512 WebP/JPEG derivative up to 524288 bytes, never its source (locally supported JPEG/PNG/WebP source up to 10 MiB/50 MP). Moscow exact avatar proxy caps payload at 524288 bytes. API defense remains maximum 5242880 bytes, 16 MP, 8192px per side, one frame; MIME must match signature/decoder. Re-encoded to sanitized 512x512 PNG without metadata; existing PNG keys/MIME remain compatible. No filename or URL accepted.

put.description: Direct owned uploads require approval for the exact sanitized 512x512 PNG (maximum 2 MiB derivative) before file staging/publication. Provider preflight is outside the publication transaction; profile version and derivative fingerprint are rechecked at commit. Failure preserves the previous avatar. Existing avatars remain legacy/unreviewed. Trusted VK/Yandex provider fallback is not re-moderated.

get.summary: Complete bounded city-wide canonical Venue aggregate of upcoming public Games
get.description: No cursor/limit/bbox; unknown/repeated/empty parameters or raw query over 8KiB are rejected. All matching Games are aggregated before previews. Hard bounds: 200 mappable Venues, 20000 matching Games and 2MiB encoded JSON; overflow returns 422 GAME_MAP_QUERY_TOO_BROAD with no partial items. SQL deadline 1500ms, whole query deadline 2500ms; unavailable/integrity failure returns safe 503 GAME_MAP_TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE. All responses no-store. No authorization, GPS or Radar dependency.

cookieSession.name: __Host-gb_session
cookieSession.description: Opaque consumer session. Cookie-auth mutations also require CSRF token and Origin validation.

bearerSession.description: GoBadminton application access token, never provider access token

AdminSessionCookie.name: __Host-gb_admin_session
AdminSessionCookie.description: Separate host-only Secure HttpOnly Admin cookie. Never consumer session/bearer; active principal and WebAuthn credential checked from DB on each request.

AdminMfaTicket.name: __Host-gb_admin_mfa
AdminMfaTicket.description: Pending identity ticket; cannot authorize privileged requests.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Scoped to actor+operation. Different payload under the same key is a conflict.

CsrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
CsrfToken.description: MANDATORY for cookie-auth mutations; omitted only for non-cookie bearer clients. Server also validates Origin.

ShareToken.name: X-Game-Share-Token
ShareToken.description: Unlisted game access only. Must be redacted from logs. Not organizer authority.

Problem.description: Problem details with safe code and requestId; no internals/PII

Game.description: Game DTO; no applicant roster or private account fields

ManagedGamePage.description: Private managed-games cursor page; Cache-Control: no-store

AvatarProblem.description: Safe application problem or early Fastify transport rejection (unsupported MIME / body size). Upload moderation failures: 422 PUBLIC_IMAGE_CONTENT_REJECTED; 503 MODERATION_TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE or MODERATION_POLICY_MISMATCH; 429 MODERATION_RATE_LIMITED (GoBadminton actor budget only). No provider categories/scores are exposed.

csrfToken.description: Send as X-CSRF-Token on cookie-auth mutations

OrganizerSummary.description: Per-game host publication snapshot. Not a global organizer authority claim.

id.description: Legacy organizer entity id when present; null for games created under game-scoped authority

publicContact.description: Explicit per-game host contact snapshot, not a player's private contact

trainer.description: Null for regular games even if creator has a TrainerProfile

title.description: Optional custom title, trimmed by the server (max 160 after trimming). Missing or blank defaults to Игра for regular or Игра с тренером for trainer_led. Stored title remains non-null.

trainingDescription.description: Optional for trainer_led; rejected for regular

savePublicContactDefault.description: Explicit atomic save of normalized hostPublicContact as own default; omit to leave preference unchanged. Conflict rolls back game, owner, creator seat and event.

CreateGame.description: New regular drafts initialize exactly one real confirmed creator seat; capacity includes creator plus external reservations. Trainer-led and historical games unchanged.

sourceCode.description: Untrusted attribution hint; not permission or proof of new client

isCreatorOrganizer.description: Server-derived equality with immutable game creator; management authority is separate. Present on participation roster/own reads and participation commands; optional for legacy invitation receipts.

createdByMe.description: True when games.created_by_user_id equals the authenticated session user. Derived server-side; never client-supplied.

expectedVersion.description: Required when updating an existing profile

canRequestContact.description: Current server-owned first-contact eligibility for this authenticated viewer. False for guests/self, feature-off, ineligible actors/targets, blocks or an existing direct conversation. Missing on an older server must be treated as unavailable. Read only; POST revalidates current state. No private policy or location fields are exposed.

RadarNearbyResponse.description: One eligible peer suffices. Items are normative nearest-first by coarse proximity band and private 1km distance bucket, with viewer/epoch keyed ties; capped at 20. No precise distance or peer coordinates are exposed.

discoveryProof.description: Optional viewer/session/generation-bound Radar resultRef. Redeemed against current activations, versions, owner session, expiry, radius/cohort, block and eligibility. Not a bearer grant. Omit for ordinary directory contact.

gameContextId.description: Optional typed Game context for applicant↔manager clarification DM (P-GC-04). Does not grant Game Chat membership or bypass DM consent/block checks.

dmUnread.description: Accepted unmuted DM threads with incoming unread; excludes pending requests

gameChatUnread.description: Eligible unmuted Game Chat threads with incoming unread

returnPath.description: Allowlisted local path only; open redirects rejected

uploadedUrl.description: Owned sanitized 512px PNG. No original is retained.

providerUrl.description: HTTPS linked-provider image on avatars.yandex.net or *.userapi.com; browser-only fallback, never fetched by API. Unknown provider hosts fall back to initials.

providerUrl.description: HTTPS linked-provider image on avatars.yandex.net or *.userapi.com; browser-only fallback, never fetched by API. Unknown provider hosts fall back to initials.

GamePreferences.description: Private account-owned template. Absent row: null/version 0. Never copied from providers or exposed in directory; independent of game snapshots.

PatchGamePreferences.description: Trim contact; null explicitly clears. Stale version returns 409 VERSION_CONFLICT.

origin.description: Optional evidence marker for initial regular-draft creator seat. No requested event/self notification. Consumer must revalidate current game lifecycle before delivery; absence means ordinary confirmation.

ParticipationConfirmedPayload.description: Sanitized internal participation.confirmed outbox payload. Never contains contact defaults/provider identity/roster. Legacy outbox is KEEP_AS_EVIDENCE, not a notification queue.

DiscoveryCityId.description: Moscow + Moscow Oblast or Saint Petersburg + Leningrad Oblast; no other cities accepted.

DiscoveryCityHint.description: Public nonpersistent bootstrap hint. Inference is disabled in this source candidate; always returns Moscow/default. No address, coordinates or account preference.

DiscoveryPreference.description: Own private explicit city choice, independent of SocialProfile and Radar. Absent row is null/version 0; account deletion clears city and retains a version tombstone. Never inferred or publicly projected.

PutDiscoveryPreference.description: Explicit manual choice; null/unknown city or extra fields (including userId) return 422. Atomic first write requires version 0; each success increments once. Stale/exhausted version returns 409 VERSION_CONFLICT.

response.description: WebAuthn RegistrationResponseJSON or AuthenticationResponseJSON; verified server-side including UV, RP ID, origin, challenge, signature and counter.

options.description: WebAuthn JSON creation or request options; userVerification required.
